== English errata comparison ==
The comparison separates the printed English face from independently sourced Decipher and PC replacements. The rendered Glossary Version 2.0, p. 26, prints literal W before Landspeed in the same body font as the surrounding words. The June 2017 PC slip prints a star. Both documented presentations are retained. Source: [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Decipher Glossary Version 2.0]], p. 26. Comparison: [[Media:SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf|SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook]], Appendix A, p. 105. Same-word duplicate image articles resolve to the retained state through redirects; their existing image originals remain available. Existing gameplay identifiers are retained. Japanese, Revised, foil and virtual articles are outside this English comparison.
